environment.method: One warm-up and five sequential samples per case and owner, both owners measured on the same seeded database so the pair shares data and cache state. Statement counts come from the Drizzle query logger. Plans come from one additional untimed EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, SETTINGS, FORMAT JSON) per distinct statement of the last sample. The fixture has no live Runner connection, so every outcome is no_connection, exactly as in the audit. Local Docker microbenchmark with default service query deadlines; not production capacity.
